Jesus is baptized, Matthew 3. He stepped into the river with the crowds, to fulfil all righteousness, and the voice from heaven, this is my beloved Son, the Spirit of God was seen. Jesus did not need sin washed away, He did it to stand with us and to begin His public work in order. The Father is pleased when the Son is obeyed, and the rest of us, when we trust Him, are adopted into the same love story.
